Diagnosis: The previous output used two freeze_position constraints: one to keep panda_fingertip fixed (correct per the subtask), and a second incorrectly applied to the top_drawer_handle_frame gripped_object (to represent 'stop when object is released'). However, the schema allows only one position op per constraints list. The second freeze_position is not allowed and not a literal positional freeze of the object while it is being released. The correct interpretation is to maintain the gripper's position and orientation fixed (with freeze_position and freeze_orientation on panda_fingertip), require the gripper to open, and allow successful completion when the gripper is open and the handle is released (but NOT via a positional constraint on the handle). Removed the conflicting redundant freeze_position on top_drawer_handle_frame.
Reasoning: Success for this subtask is defined by three explicit requirements: 1) The gripper's (panda_fingertip) position and orientation must remain fixed in the agent (robot base) frame throughout the action; this requires both freeze_position and freeze_orientation on the gripper. 2) The gripper fingers must transition from closed (grasp) to fully open; this requires open_gripper. 3) The action must complete when the gripper is fully open and no longer exerts significant grip effort (the grasp is released) on the top_drawer_handle_frame; this is indicated by low arm contact force/effort (manipulator_low_effort). Only objects and robot frames from Observations are referenced (all requirements are clear from the subtask). The position schema restricts to only one positional op, so freeze_position can be applied only to the gripper as required by the subtask.
